summary: AI Workspace Assistant (omnipresent) tested end-to-end. All 9 backend pytest cases pass (suggestions generic/document/project shape+chip contents; transform-section improve returns apply.mode=section+target+value+report; transform-document translate returns apply.mode=document with per-key values and list-type preservation; info summarize returns markdown answer + report with apply=null; unknown command → 400; SSE /assistant/chat/stream emits data:{delta:...} then data:{done:true, report:{...}} with text/event-stream content-type; history is org-isolated between two demo tenants). Frontend Playwright verified 20/20 steps: demo login, FAB visible on dashboard (opened via JS due to Emergent badge overlap — same pattern the request called out), panel opens with context 'your dashboard', close works. On project Brand Redesign → Proposal tab: context line says 'the Brand Redesign — Proposal', section-select present, 8 suggestion chips rendered (improve/exec_summary/pricing/weak/tone/translate/email/faq). Regression: rapid tab switching contract→invoice→planner→proposal produced ZERO 'Maximum update depth' errors. Slash '/summarize' returned a report. TRANSFORM chip 'improve' returned Apply button; Apply → Undo lifecycle works. Copy + Regenerate buttons present. /ai-workspace and /ai-chat still render. No infinite render loop regression.

issues: FAB at bottom-20 right-6 overlaps the 'Made with Emergent' preview badge (bottom-right). Normal Playwright click was intercepted; JS .click() works. In production the badge is absent so end-users are unaffected, but consider nudging FAB up (e.g. bottom-24) or shifting left in preview mode to remove the visual crowding.

action_items: (Optional) Adjust FAB position so it doesn't sit under the 'Made with Emergent' preview badge (only visible in preview envs).

(Cosmetic) When applying 'improve' on the seeded proposal whose sections are empty strings, the model correctly returns 0 changed sections and the report says 'No changes were made'. This is expected behaviour but a UX polish idea: surface a friendlier 'nothing to improve yet — add content first' hint when apply.values is empty.
critical_code_review_comments: assistant.py _split_meta: on the info branch the model is asked to append '@@META@@{json}'. If the model omits the marker, meta is {} and the report lacks what/why/impact — the code correctly defaults 'what' to the action label and leaves why/impact empty. Fine, but consider a soft fallback prompt-retry if meta missing.

AssistantContext.hasDocument is derived as !!docRef.current from a ref inside the provider value. React won't re-render children when docRef mutates; the code intentionally bumps docTick to force it. That works, but effectiveContext/buildPayload depend on docTick via 'void docTick' which is a bit fragile — a follow-up refactor could store the doc handle in state directly for clarity.

FloatingAssistant.jsx runAction: the transform chip uses targetKey from state; if the user changes the section-select while the request is in flight, the current in-flight request still runs against the old key. Not a bug (payload was already sent) but worth a comment.

chat/stream: SSE 'gen' async generator awaits _persist(full) inside 'finally' — persist happens after the browser receives 'done'. If persist ever throws, the client already got done and is fine, but the exception surfaces as a 500 in the response tail (masked by StreamingResponse). Non-blocking.
Confidence heuristic (_confidence) mixes 88 + ctx bonus + len-based bonus, capped at 98. Presented to end users as a percentage — perfectly fine for UX but not a real calibration. OK for MVP.
test_credentials: POST /api/auth/demo (accessToken in response body). No user creds needed — the 'Explore Demo' button on /login provisions an isolated tenant seeded with project 'Brand Redesign' + proposal v2 + plan.
seed_data_creation: Each test relies on the /api/auth/demo seed (Halcyon Group client, Brand Redesign project, versioned proposal + plan). No extra fixtures created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Assistant testids: assistant-fab (open via JS in preview due to Emergent badge overlap), assistant-panel, assistant-context-line, assistant-close, assistant-section-select, assistant-suggestions with assistant-chip-<command> children, assistant-input, assistant-send, assistant-apply-btn, assistant-undo-btn, assistant-copy-btn, assistant-regenerate-btn, assistant-report, assistant-error, assistant-welcome, assistant-messages, assistant-msg-user/assistant. Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_assistant.py (9 cases, ~11s). LLM calls use gpt-5.4 via Emergent universal key; tests gracefully skip on 502 budget errors.
